subject: Acme pricing deck & estimate
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Acme pricing deck & estimate

Hi Alex —

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps from our discovery call: 

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for customer-facing recommendations while cutting per-token cost.
- Current constraints: multi-region rollout, data residency for EU customers, target Q4 launch.
- Success metric: 95th percentile latency < 200ms for 1k qps, and cost reduction of ~30% vs current infra.

I've attached the pricing deck and the estimate we discussed; the estimate includes two sizing options (standard and reserved/dedicated). Key ask from you: confirm which option you want us to model (standard vs dedicated capacity) and preferred contract term (12 vs 24 months).

Attachments: Acme_Redwood_Pricing_Deck_v2.pdf (PDF, 3.1MB); Acme_Estimate_2026-07-08.xlsx (Excel, 45KB)

Proposed next steps:
1) I can walk the team through the deck — 20-30 min walkthrough.
2) If procurement needs details, happy to provide a mutual action plan + timelines.
3) If you'd like, I can run a quick throughput/latency estimate with the sample traces you mentioned.

Are you available Thursday or Friday morning for a quick walkthrough? If procurement should be included, loop them in and I’ll share a tailored MAP.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--

Acme_Estimate_2026-07-08.xlsx (attached)
